$Comment: A station is an ordered list of self-contained ACTIONS; this one has a single action, Mill, attached by Ref from Actions/Mill.json, and everything about how milling runs is inside that file, each group with its own $Comment explaining exactly what it does. Icon intentionally omitted: the engine falls back to the anchor block's own BlockType id at engage time when Identity.Icon is absent, and this jar's default Sawmill block shares the same id (RPG_Station_Sawmill, filename = item id), so the summary-HUD crest shows the block's own icon with zero duplicated id to drift.

Block.$Comment: Exclusive true means one worker at a time - a property of the placed block, never of the job.

Actions.$Comment: Id 'Mill' is technically optional (an id-less entry answers to its array position), but authoring it is load-bearing: the id is what an ExtensionAsset targets (the sibling pack's contribution extension aims at exactly {Station 'Sawmill', Action 'Mill'}), what a custody claim records across a relog, and what stays stable when actions are reordered - a positional id changes the moment an action is inserted above it, which is the exact implicit-order fragility this schema exists to avoid. Author an Id on every action you expect anyone to extend. Every key under the action's Moments is a MOMENT ID the engine emits: cycle, swing, impact, completion, a per-step step:<actionId>:<stepId>, or a cue:<name> a loot roll names. The body lives in Actions/Mill.json, attached here by Ref: the station entry and the action asset share the id Mill, so an extension aimed at {Station: Sawmill, Action: Mill} reaches it exactly as before, and a pack may give Mill a variant by Parent.
